title: royascaff deprecate: data
description: The `data` of the contract envelope for `deprecate`. A requirement or component is scheduled for removal: it gets `Status: deprecated` and a `Removal slice` (`removal_slice`; `planned_slice` is true when the call planned that slice). The code map of a task then shows the code of a deprecated component as scheduled for removal. Extra fields are allowed: adding a field is a minor change.
